# Nitrosend Safe Mode MAP 0.3 Campaign Approval Report

- **Install, runtime, and exact commands:** Installed `mailschema` via `npm install mailschema@0.3.2` (`mailschema --version` `0.3.2`) on Node.js `v24.15.0` (Linux x86_64). Configured Brand Kit physical address (`PATCH /v1/my/brands/a23fc37b44250f3391f7e340`), enabled Safe Mode (`PATCH /v1/my/account {"safe_mode_enabled":true}`), and had the API-key-authenticated agent (`aether-run`) create contact `4068934`, list `12980`, and campaign `15572` (`Biweekly Go Consensus Integrity Summary v2`, no merge tags), then call `POST /v1/my/campaigns/15572/send` (`deliver_at: 2026-10-29T04:25:29Z`), holding the send as `awaiting_approval` (approval `id: 502`).
- **Minutes from Safe Mode on to decision:** `1.8` minutes (`106` seconds) from enabling Safe Mode (`2026-10-29T03:55:24Z`) and `102` seconds (`1.71` minutes) from holding the campaign (`issuedAt: 2026-10-29T03:55:31Z`) to extracting `description_4.json`, validating against `campaign-send-approval-0.1.json`, recomputing `terms.version`, and recording the approval decision (`decided_at: 2026-10-29T03:57:13.535Z`).
- **Validate command and exact output:** Saved the MAP 0.3 description from the held approval to `description_4.json` and ran `./node_modules/.bin/mailschema description description_4.json --contract campaign-send-approval-0.1.json`. Exact output:
  `Valid MAP 0.3 description urn:uuid:b1a6b8d1-a329-5028-93d0-9a14d3f34a21`
  `sha-256:bfaf31f7989e9a53fa407a3fe664192d4a236225d8ee195da96602e386c3e046`
- **How `terms.version` was recomputed and exact value:** Cloned `description_4.json`, deleted `terms.version`, and passed the object to `digest()` from `mailschema` (`import { digest } from "mailschema"`). Both `terms.version` and the recomputed digest equaled `sha-256:974d18e66e97f03318cb3b6e0fa125f171ff5214b53d99df84875cca64197db6` (`match: true`).
- **Decision and why:** Approved (`decision: "approve"` at `terms.id` `https://api.nitrosend.com/v1/my/map/approvals/502`) after completing contract validation (`102` seconds after `issuedAt`) because `description_4.json` passed `Campaign Send Approval 0.1` validation, `terms.version` matched the canonical digest, and `details.audience.count` was `1` (the owner address).
- **Step that slowed the run most, defect/doc gap, and one change:** Slowest step: `PATCH /v1/my/campaigns/15572` requires `template_attributes.if_version` to match the current template revision before scheduling (`POST /v1/my/campaigns/15572/send`). Checked Safe Mode docs, `https://mailschema.org/specification/core`, and `mailschema@0.3.2` README (`npx mailschema message` and `digest()`); no MAP defects found. Change: add a `--verify-terms-version` flag to `mailschema description` CLI so `terms.version` digest verification runs in one command.
